name: using-superpowers
description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring Skill tool invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions
notes: Adapted from Claude Code Superpowers (MIT, obra/superpowers). Tool mapping: Claude Code Skill tool -> HanCode skill tool; TodoWrite/EnterPlanMode do not exist in HanCode - track checklists inline in your responses and proceed without plan-mode. Other tool names (bash, read_file, edit_file, agent) map directly.
